mostWorthwhile.text: Following fat into lymph was worthwhile because it showed how its route differs from glucose and amino acids going into blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated need to use the villus as a location was confusing: I expected to combine the materials directly both times.

surprise.text: Fat entered intestinal cells before it was rebuilt and packaged into particles called chylomicrons.

arbitrary.text: Combining glucose and amino acids with each other to show their shared route toward the liver felt less obvious than using a vessel or location.

continue.text: I would try another chapter to see where the nutrients go next, though I would hope the required locations are clearer.
